appearances.title: Tencent opens Hy4 flash weights: 224B total, 12B active, 1M context, natively multimodal, with FP8 and Base variants
appearances.summary: Tencent released downloadable weights for Hy4 flash, including an FP8 build and a Base model, under the Tencent Hy License. The post links a Hugging Face repo, a GitHub repo and a research page; a roster account estimates NVFP4 at about 220 GB, so two DGX Sparks would be needed.
